title: QBIND Public DevNet — Aggregate Status / Health View
description: Publish-safe schema for a future QBIND public DevNet aggregate health view (Run 395, S5, Route B). This is a DECISION + SCHEMA artifact only; it does NOT describe a deployed status service and MUST NOT be read as one. Any instance is illustrative example data unless it is generated from a real live network, which does not exist while M4 is Yellow. The schema deliberately forbids uptime/SLA fields, private endpoints, raw logs, raw metrics dumps, secrets, data-dir paths, and absolute paths.

schema_version.description: Schema version this instance conforms to.

network.description: Must be the public DevNet label. No TestNet/MainNet value is permitted by this schema.

safety.description: Mandatory safety envelope. Every flag is fixed so an instance cannot silently drop a disclaimer.

example_data_only.description: True for any instance not generated from a real live network. Static examples MUST set this true.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the view was generated. No uptime/duration is derived from this.

data_source.description: Provenance of the values. 'static-example' means illustrative placeholder data. A live value requires a real, externally reachable network (M4 Green), which does not exist yet.

genesis.description: Canonical genesis identity operators verify with --expect-genesis-hash.

build.description: Public, non-sensitive release build info (mirrors qbind_node_build_info labels).

seed_list.description: Published seed-list status. Endpoints are only included when intentionally public; otherwise counts only.

status.description: 'planned' until a real externally reachable seed exists (M4). 'live' requires M4 Green.

public_endpoints.description: OPTIONAL. Only intentionally-public seed endpoints (host:port). Omit entirely unless the endpoint is meant to be public. Never include private/internal addresses.

readiness.description: Aggregate readiness rollup mirroring the readiness matrix. Colors are the only permitted values.

metrics_endpoint.description: Status of the observability metrics endpoint posture. No address is published (loopback-only by design).

exposure.description: Metrics are loopback-only by default (QBIND_METRICS_HTTP_ADDR). No public address is ever published here.

alerts.description: Summary of the shipped alert package (counts only; no raw alert payloads).

package.description: Reference to the shipped observability alert/scrape package (Run 379–381).

firing.description: Count of currently firing alerts. Static examples use 0. Never embed raw alert bodies or metric dumps.

notices.description: Incident / reset notices (publish-safe summaries only; no raw logs, no secrets, no private endpoints).

summary.description: Short redacted summary. No absolute paths, no data dirs, no raw logs, no secrets.

reference.description: OPTIONAL repository-relative reference to a published incident/reset record.
